text:
CI Bot: CI job integration-tests #1245 failed on branch `main` — 12 failing tests. Logs: https://ci.redwood/tests/1245 — root cause looks like 502s from mock-auth-proxy during token exchange.

sam: ugh, saw this. pinging @jin to triage — these are flapping in CI a lot lately.

jin: on it, pulling logs now. trying a local repro against the CI env.

jin: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-16T18:12:34Z] ERROR auth-proxy: upstream request failed: 502 Bad Gateway, connection reset
stack: http://127.0.0.1:8000/token -> upstream 10.2.34.12:8443
```

maria: can we just rerun to confirm infra vs test bug?

sam: @CI Bot rerun 1245

CI Bot: Rerun queued as job #1246 (integration-tests).

CI Bot: Job #1246 failed — same 502s from mock-auth-proxy.

asha: looks like the mock that issues tokens might be unhealthy. I saw a bot alert about container restarts earlier.

jin: checking pod status: ```
$ kubectl -n ci get pods | grep mock-auth
mock-auth-3   CrashLoopBackOff   1/1   0   5m
```

ops-bot: Restarting pod `mock-auth-3` in namespace `ci` (requested by jin).

jin: pod restarted. doing another rerun.

sam: @CI Bot rerun 1245 -- note: restarted mock-auth pod

CI Bot: Rerun queued as job #1247.

CI Bot: Job #1247 passed — all integration tests green.

maria: nice. looks like transient mock crash. I'll mark the flaky group for the auth tests so they don't block merges while we fix infra.

jin: root cause appears to be a memory leak in mock-auth when under load; reproducing locally with load test.

asha: next steps: add a liveness & memory limit to the mock deployment, and add an alert when restarts > 1 in 10m.

sam: action items: (1) jin to open PR for liveness + limits, (2) ops to add alert, (3) maria to add flaky tag to sensitive tests.

jin: will open PR shortly and link load-test results.

ops-bot: Noted. Created alert ticket: INFRA-4821.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup:

sam: closing thread. if it pops again, escalate to oncall.
